source_layers.handwriting: Striking/overwriting occurs over the phrase; a margin annotation appears to contain ear of danger. It is not attributed to Lilly or treated as the correction authority.

source_layers.admitted_reading: With the stated reception and fortunate Moon, after feare of danger a little hopes remaines. This is the corrected reading, not a claim that the overwritten original line was fully legible.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord and Moon are conjunct eighth lord.
No interposing aspects of the Fortunes occur.
assertion: This threatens death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Eighth lord is in an angle.
Ascendant lord is in a cadent house.
assertion: The source says this is always mortal, the rather if he is an Infortune.
uncertainty: The pronoun he in the strengthening clause likely concerns eighth lord but is not resolved into an extra required condition.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Moon applies to a planet in the eighth.
assertion: This is always dangerous.
uncertainty: The source’s danger is not silently upgraded to certain death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord applies to eighth lord OR malevolent planets in the eighth.
Moon is corrupt in any manner.
assertion: This denotes death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Moon transfers the light and influence of ascendant lord to eighth lord.
assertion: This usually brings death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Eighth lord is in ascendant.
Ascendant lord and Moon are both afflicted.
assertion: The source says likewise to the preceding usually-death testimony.
uncertainty: The nearby usually is carried as the antecedent’s modality rather than silently strengthened to always.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord is unfortunate in eighth.
Moon is corrupted OR very weak, and in no essential dignity.

condition_logic.expression: L1 unfortunate in eighth; Moon “corrupted or very weak, and in no essential Dignity”; preserve alternative and conjunctive phrase without forcing scope.

assertion: This also proves fatal.
uncertainty: The scope of no essential dignity over the corrupted/very-weak alternative is not fully explicit.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord is subterranean.
He has any aspect to eighth lord in eighth.
assertion: This argues death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord is in fourth.
Eighth lord is in fourth.
They are conjunct.
assertion: This argues death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord is corporally joined to fourth, sixth, seventh, OR twelfth lord.
assertion: This is a very ill sign of life; it seldom succeeds well with the sick person.
uncertainty: Seldom succeeds well is not converted into inevitable death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Judging these illness testimonies.
assertion: The source directs special consideration of the luminary of the time; according to its good or ill condition one may improve judgment.
uncertainty: No numeric weighting or override rule is supplied here.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord is afflicted by an evil planet in eighth.
No benevolent aspect of Fortunes occurs.
Moon is also vitiated.
assertion: The source shows great peril of death, usually attributing it to ill government of the sick party or some error in ordering and course of physic.
uncertainty: The historical blame/treatment attribution is not evidence of actual patient conduct or treatment efficacy.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: At the first question to the physician, ascendant lord is combust in ascendant.
assertion: This is a powerful argument that the sick party will die.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord and eighth lord are unfortunate.
assertion: They prenote death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Eighth lord is in tenth.
Ascendant lord is in fourth, sixth, OR seventh, afflicted by malevolent planets.
assertion: These argue death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: A planet is very strong and in ascendant.
That planet is lord of the hour and of eighth.
assertion: It portends death.
uncertainty: Very strong is not assigned a numeric threshold here.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Eighth lord is retrograde.
Eighth lord is conjunct, square, OR opposite Moon.
assertion: It shows death.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Eighth lord is in seventh.
Moon and ascendant lord are cadent and infected with ill aspects of Infortunes.
assertion: This is a death testimony in the section’s sequence, more certain if one malevolent is eighth lord or is in eighth.
uncertainty: The sentence omits an independent finite outcome before its certainty clause; outcome is inherited from local death-argument context.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Moon is conjunct Saturn OR Jupiter.
assertion: Some say the sickness receives little good thereby and the sick will not escape.
exceptions: Unless Saturn is retrograde AND Jupiter direct.
uncertainty: The printed or and the exception naming both planets are retained.
This attributed variant is not reconciled by deleting the distinct Jupiter-recovery testimony.
attribution: Lilly reporting “some say”; named authority unspecified

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord is conjunct eighth lord, OR square/conjunct a planet in eighth, OR in eighth lord’s antiscion.
The benevolent sextile OR trine of Jupiter is absent.
Moon is in any way afflicted at the same time.
assertion: It is probable the sick will die.
exceptions: If ascendant lord is in reception with the planet in eighth, escape from death is possible; however, a very long and grievous disease cannot be avoided.
uncertainty: Reception exception refers to a planet in eighth; its scope over every earlier alternative is not fully restated.
Source probability is qualitative, not a numerical estimate.

source_layers.original_print: The Antiscion phrase visibly concerns the Lord of the eight followed by an overmarked terminal character.
source_layers.handwriting: An overmark on the terminal character is visible and not assigned authorial authority.
source_layers.admitted_reading: The eighth lord; source errata is preserved as a separate spelling/reading correction.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Moon is with Saturn OR Mars.
Good aspect assistance from Jupiter and Venus is absent.

condition_logic.expression: Moon with Saturn/Mars; absence of source-stated Jupiter-and-Venus assistance; IF Saturn slow/retrograde then worse; IF other testimonies concur then more certain.

assertion: This is one argument the sick will die then; Saturn being slow or going retrograde makes it worse, and other concurrent testimonies make it more certain.
uncertainty: The text says from Jupiter and Venus; whether either assistance suffices or both are required is not converted into an executable choice.
The and-if Saturn escalation remains additional rather than silently required in the Mars branch.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord is in seventh, in his fall, OR under earth in fourth or sixth, OR other cadent houses, afflicted by malevolents.
Eighth lord is in seventh.

condition_logic.expression: Source sequence: L1 in seventh, in fall, or under earth in fourth/sixth, or other cadents, afflicted by malevolents; AND L8 in seventh. Exact grouping unresolved.

assertion: These are testimonies of death.
uncertainty: Punctuation does not settle whether in seventh and in his fall are conjunctive, or how affliction scopes over the place alternatives.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: A malevolent planet is near the ascending degree, OR a violent fixed star is there.
The source’s examples are Antares in the fourth degree of Sagittarius, Lans/Lanx Australis about the ninth of Scorpio, Palilicium in four Gemini, and Caput Medusae in twenty Taurus.

condition_logic.expression: Malevolent near ascending degree OR violent fixed star there; historical example list is descriptive, not an AND condition.

assertion: These prenote death.
uncertainty: Near is not given an orb.
The name printed as Lans/Lanx Australis is not silently corrected; identity spelling remains a paleographic uncertainty.
The stated degrees are historical source coordinates, not present-day positions.
The star list supplies examples rather than an additional requirement that every star be present.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Ascendant lord is in Leo OR Aquarius.
He is in any bad configuration of sixth OR twelfth lord.
assertion: This shows little hope of recovery.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Both Lights are afflicted by Saturn in angles.
assertion: They testify to a tedious long sickness.
uncertainty: The angular phrase’s exact attachment is not fully explicit.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Both Lights are ill dignified and under earth.
assertion: They signify the same tedious long sickness.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: From the disease’s beginning Sun is corporally afflicted, OR impeded by Saturn/Mars square/opposition, OR in perfect antiscion of a malignant planet, OR applies and does not separate.

condition_logic.expression: Beginning-of-disease Sun condition: bodily affliction OR Saturn/Mars square/opposition OR perfect antiscion of malignant OR applies-not-separates; last alternative’s object/scope unresolved.

assertion: Either death or extraordinarily long sickness succeeds.
uncertainty: The target of applying and not separating is not restated; exact scope over preceding alternatives remains unresolved.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: After disease begins Moon comes to opposition of ascendant lord.
Ascendant lord is retrograde OR combust.
assertion: This argues death OR a sharp disease not easily curable.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Saturn is opposite eighth lord.
Moon is in fourth with Mars, OR Moon is in ascendant and near the ascending degree.

condition_logic.expression: Unresolved source list: Saturn opposite L8, Moon in fourth with Mars, OR Moon in ascendant AND near ascending degree; conjunctive/list scope unresolved.

assertion: The printed configuration sequence is called arguments of death.
uncertainty: The source may list distinct testimonies or require a combined sequence; it is not normalized into independent unconditional rules.
Near is unquantified.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Moon is besieged by Infortunes, OR between Sun and Mars, OR between Sun and Saturn.
assertion: These are ill omens of health.
uncertainty: Besiegement is not assigned a numeric span in this passage.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: The person falls sick while Moon is under Sun’s beams, identified here as departing combustion.

condition_logic.expression: At onset Moon under beams/departing combustion -> increase until passed Sun opposition; THEN IF Moon ill affected AND comes to ill aspect of L8 -> threatens death; ELSE escape.

assertion: The disease shall increase until Moon has passed Sun’s opposition. If Moon then proves ill affected and comes to an ill aspect of eighth lord, it threatens death; otherwise the person escapes.
exceptions: After the specified stage, absence of the ill-affected/ill-eighth-aspect branch yields the explicit escape alternative.
uncertainty: No orb for beams/combustion or ill aspect is supplied in this passage.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Any malevolent is in sixth, OR any planet is peregrine AND unfortunate in sixth.
assertion: These show great danger in the disease.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: The source sequence begins Moon’s combustion in eighth house, and in Leo, or in Libra.
It continues square OR opposition to Saturn OR Mercury, OR conjunction with Pleiades in 24 Taurus OR other violent fixed stars.

condition_logic.expression: Preserve sequence without executable resolution: combustion of Moon in eighth AND in Leo OR Libra, square/opposition Saturn OR Mercury, OR conjunction Pleiades at 24 Taurus OR other violent stars.

assertion: The source calls the sequence an argument of death.
uncertainty: A strict conjunction of all clauses would conflict with the listed alternative sign positions; exact AND/OR grouping remains unresolved.
Mercury’s printed glyph is visually verified and is not replaced by Mars.
The Pleiades coordinate is the historical source value, not a current coordinate.

section: Arguments of Death
conditions: Moon is lady of sixth OR ascendant and is in combustion.
At the same time eighth lord is afflicted by conjunction OR ill aspect of Saturn OR Mars.
assertion: These show death. This is the final included sentence before DARIOT Abridged.
uncertainty: Combustion is read as applying to Moon in the lordship alternatives; no numeric combustion threshold is imported.
